name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with ESR
description: Measures red blood cells, hemoglobin, white blood cell count and differentials, platelet count, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate.
whatItChecks: Infections, anemia, immune response, blood disorders, and platelet levels (vital during fever/dengue monitoring).
preparation: No special fasting required. Can be performed at any time of day.

name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
description: Evaluates the percentage of hemoglobin coated with sugar, providing an accurate 90-day glycemic snapshot immune to short-term meal fluctuations.
whatItChecks: Long-term blood glucose regulation, diabetes diagnosis, and therapy effectiveness.
preparation: No fasting required. Any time of day.

name: Comprehensive Lipid Profile
description: Comprehensive cardiac risk panel measuring Total Cholesterol, HDL (good cholesterol), LDL (bad cholesterol), VLDL, and Triglycerides.
whatItChecks: Cardiovascular risk, arterial plaque vulnerability, and lipid metabolism.
preparation: Requires 10 to 12 hours of overnight fasting (water is allowed).

name: Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH)
description: Assesses triiodothyronine (T3), thyroxine (T4), and thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) to identify hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism.
whatItChecks: Metabolic rate, unexplained weight changes, mood and energy fluctuations, and thyroid gland abnormalities.
preparation: Morning sample preferred before taking thyroid medications.

name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
description: Measures total and direct bilirubin, SGOT/AST, SGPT/ALT, Alkaline Phosphatase, Total Protein, and Albumin.
whatItChecks: Liver health, jaundice, enzyme leakage, medication safety, and protein synthesis.
preparation: 8 hours fasting recommended for optimal accuracy.

name: Kidney Function Test (KFT / RFT)
description: Evaluates Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), Uric Acid, Calcium, and eGFR (estimated glomerular filtration rate).
whatItChecks: Renal filtration efficiency, hydration status, waste excretion, and early kidney stress.
preparation: Normal hydration; avoid heavy meat meals right before testing.

name: Vitamin D (25-OH) & Vitamin B12 Duo
tagline: Essential Micronutrients for Bone & Nerve Health
description: Assesses two most prevalent nutritional deficiencies in urban India: 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D for bones and Vitamin B12 for nerve and red cell health.
whatItChecks: Chronic body aches, fatigue, bone mineral density support, peripheral nerve tingling, and immune strength.

name: Urine Routine & Microscopic Examination
description: Detailed chemical dipstick and sediment microscopy assessing protein, glucose, ketones, pus cells, red blood cells, and crystals.
whatItChecks: Urinary tract infections (UTI), kidney inflammation, protein leakage, and crystal/stone formation.
preparation: Clean-catch midstream urine sample in a sterile container provided by CareSphere.

name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)
description: Quick, non-invasive digital recording of the heart's electrical impulses through electrodes placed on chest and limbs.
whatItChecks: Arrhythmias, ischemia (reduced heart blood flow), chamber enlargement, and prior silent cardiac events.
preparation: Wear loose comfortable clothing. No fasting needed.

name: Digital X-Ray - Chest (PA View)
description: Low-dose digital radiography visualizing the lungs, pleural spaces, heart silhouette, and thoracic rib cage.
whatItChecks: Pneumonia, respiratory infections, cardiomegaly (enlarged heart), chronic cough causes, and rib fractures.
preparation: Remove metallic jewelry and wear clinic examination gown.

name: Ultrasound Whole Abdomen & Pelvis (USG)
description: Real-time non-radiation sound wave imaging evaluating liver, gallbladder, kidneys, pancreas, spleen, urinary bladder, and pelvic organs.
whatItChecks: Fatty liver, gallstones, kidney stones, pelvic cysts, uterine fibroids, and abdominal swelling.
preparation: 6 hours fasting for abdominal scan; full urinary bladder required for pelvic clarity.
